JSON.calibration: deep_weight multiplies the obj/arr alternatives of rule 'value'; w=5 gives mean grammar depth 0.71 over 1000 draws (seed 0) vs 0.73 for the json-parser pilot's C1 seed generator (300 draws, seed 0); w=1 (defaults) gives 0.19

TOML.calibration: TOML's lexer is mode-based; the array/inline-table depth alternatives are not a single value rule, so the deep variant is not calibrated here (deep_weight 1.0 == defaults). Depth matching for TOML is left to the defaults; noted as a limitation.
